intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.zh: 圆形连接器预制电缆组件。

intro.en: Circular connectors and wire identified in manufacturer assembly tables.
intro.zh: 圆形连接器及原厂组件表中列明的线材。

checks_title.en: Six Decisions Behind the Part Number
checks_title.zh: 型号背后的六个选型要点

copy.en: Confirm the mating series, coding and contact sex from both connector drawings.
copy.zh: 结合两端连接器图纸，确认对插系列、编码与触点公母。

copy.en: Match every contact to its conductor and circuit function. Specify unused positions.
copy.zh: 逐针对应导线与电路功能，并定义空置针位。

copy.en: Set conductor size, pair construction and shielding for the actual electrical load.
copy.zh: 按实际负载确定线径、线对结构和屏蔽形式。

copy.en: Review straight or angled exits, connector clearance and minimum installation bend radius.
copy.zh: 核对直头或弯头出线、插拔空间和安装弯曲半径。

copy.en: Check seal dimensions, cable diameter and the specified locking method as one assembled interface.
copy.zh: 将密封尺寸、线缆外径和锁紧方式作为完整接口核对。

copy.en: Define continuity, insulation and mechanical checks for the approved configuration.
copy.zh: 围绕确认配置制定导通、绝缘和机械检验要求。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
